techs.name: Controlled Environments
techs.description: Sealed habitats: colonize Barren worlds (minimum habitability -20).

techs.name: Subterranean Habitats
techs.description: +20% max population on every colony. Unlocks Habitat Domes.

techs.name: Terraforming
techs.description: Colonize Toxic and Volcanic worlds (minimum habitability -15). +10% max population.

techs.name: Improved Scanners
techs.description: +50 sensor range for ships and colonies.

techs.name: Deep Space Arrays
techs.description: +80 sensor range for ships and colonies.

techs.name: Fleet Command
techs.description: Unlocks the Fleet Command Network for battleships and dreadnoughts.

techs.name: Electronic Warfare
techs.description: Unlocks the ECM Jammer against missiles and fighters.

techs.name: Cyber Warfare
techs.description: Unlocks the Cyber Warfare Suite and the Hardened Firewall.

techs.name: Cloaking
techs.description: Unlocks the Cloaking Device for small ships.

techs.name: Gauss Cannons
techs.description: Unlocks the Gauss Cannon: short-range, shield-piercing.

techs.name: Disruptor Cannons
techs.description: Unlocks the Disruptor Cannon. +10% weapon damage.

techs.name: Orbital Bombardment
techs.description: Unlocks the Orbital Bomb Bay for cruisers and larger.

techs.name: Deflector Shields
techs.description: Unlocks the Deflector I and Shield Generators.

techs.name: Point Defense
techs.description: Unlocks Point Defense against missiles and fighters.

techs.name: Extended Tanks
techs.description: +3 turns of supply for every ship. Unlocks the Supply Hold for supply ships.

techs.name: Supply Lines
techs.description: +2 turns of supply for every ship.

techs.name: Forward Depots
techs.description: Upgrade combat outposts to supply depots that supply and repair your fleets.

techs.name: Orbital Fortresses
techs.description: +15% colony defenses. Unlocks the Orbital Fortress.

techs.name: Special Operations
techs.description: Unlocks Commando Teams for sabotage missions.

techs.name: Mine Warfare
techs.description: Unlocks Minefields and the Mine Layer.

techs.name: Field Repair
techs.description: Unlocks the Repair Bay for repair tenders.

techs.name: Outpost Construction
techs.description: Unlocks the Outpost Kit: combat outposts on asteroid fields and gas giants.

techs.name: Asteroid Mining
techs.description: Mining outposts on asteroid fields: income, but no defenses.

techs.name: Fighter Squadrons
techs.description: Unlocks the Fighter Bay for cruisers and larger.

techs.name: Strike Drones
techs.description: Unlocks the Strike Drone Bay for battleships and larger.

buildings.name: Shield Generator
buildings.description: Blocks 2 damage per hit on this colony's defenses.

buildings.name: Minefield
buildings.description: Keeps 30 mine strength in this system.

buildings.name: Military Academy
buildings.description: Ships built here start as Regulars.

combat.name: Combat Outpost
combat.description: Guns and sensors on an asteroid field or gas giant: fires on enemy ships, stops ships passing through, extends sensor coverage.

mining.name: Mining Outpost
mining.description: Mines an asteroid field for credits. It has no defenses: any armed enemy fleet in the system destroys it.

depot.name: Supply Depot
depot.description: A combat outpost upgraded to resupply and repair your fleets there, like a colony.

hulls.name: Escort
hulls.description: Small hull: fast, nimble and hard to hit.

hulls.name: Freighter
hulls.description: Roomy cargo hull: slow, clumsy and unarmored.

hulls.name: Cruiser
hulls.description: Large hull: a balanced line warship. Can carry fighters and bombs.

hulls.name: Dreadnought
hulls.description: Colossal hull: the pride of the fleet, but slow to turn.

components.name: Laser
components.description: 3 damage, 75% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Mass Driver
components.description: 5 damage, 55% accuracy, short range.

components.name: Fusion Beam
components.description: 6 damage, 75% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Nuclear Missile
components.description: 12 damage, 50% accuracy, long range. Missile: point defense can shoot it down.

components.name: Titanium Armor
components.description: +8 hit points.

components.name: Neutronium Armor
components.description: +18 hit points.

components.name: Deflector I
components.description: Blocks 1 damage per hit.

components.name: Deflector III
components.description: Blocks 3 damage per hit.

components.name: Afterburner
components.description: +25 speed.

components.name: Sensor Array
components.description: +120 sensor range.

components.name: Colony Pod
components.description: Founds a colony; the ship is used up.

components.name: Fuel Tank
components.description: +4 turns of supply for the whole fleet.

components.name: Troop Pod
components.description: Carries 5 ground troops for invasions.

components.name: Repair Bay
components.description: Repairs 15% of every ship's hull per turn, even outside supply.

components.name: Mine Layer
components.description: Lays 10 mine strength per turn where the fleet waits.

components.name: Gauss Cannon
components.description: 9 damage, 65% accuracy, short range. Pierces shields.

components.name: Hellfire Missile
components.description: 16 damage, 60% accuracy, long range. Missile.

components.name: Plasma Lance
components.description: 11 damage, 75% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Starburst Torpedo
components.description: 26 damage, 55% accuracy, long range. Missile.

components.name: Disruptor Cannon
components.description: 16 damage, 70% accuracy, short range. Pierces shields.

components.name: Fighter Bay
components.description: Launches 3 fighters: 4 damage, 80% accuracy each, any range. They hunt support ships and slip past screens; point defense shoots them down. Cruiser or larger.

components.name: Strike Drone Bay
components.description: Launches 4 drones: 6 damage, 85% accuracy each, any range. Like fighters. Battleship or larger.

components.name: Point Defense
components.description: Each mount gives a 15% chance to shoot down every missile or fighter aimed at its fleet (up to 60%).

components.name: Targeting Computer
components.description: +15% accuracy for this ship's weapons.

components.name: ECM Jammer
components.description: Missiles and fighters aimed at this ship are 25% less likely to hit.

components.name: Cyber Warfare Suite
components.description: Each round, a 15% chance per suite in the fleet to shut down each enemy ship's weapons for the round (up to 40%).

components.name: Hardened Firewall
components.description: Cuts the enemy's cyber attack chance against this fleet by 15%.

components.name: Combat Thrusters
components.description: +1 maneuver: helps the fleet set the battle range, +3% evasion.

components.name: Crystalline Armor
components.description: +32 hit points.

components.name: Deflector V
components.description: Blocks 5 damage per hit.

components.name: Orbital Bomb Bay
components.description: Bombards a colony whose orbital defenses are down: 10 damage a turn to population, garrison and buildings. Cruiser or larger.

components.name: Outpost Kit
components.description: Builds an outpost on an asteroid field or gas giant; the ship is used up.

components.name: Commando Team
components.description: Special forces for sabotage: hit a rival colony's defenses, garrison or buildings.

components.name: Cloaking Device
components.description: A fleet made only of cloaked ships is seen only at a third of normal sensor range, slips past blockades and avoids battle unless it attacks. Hulls of 3 slots or fewer.

components.name: Supply Hold
components.description: Carries 20 ship-turns of stores: each turn in the field the fleet draws a turn of supply from them (one ship-turn per ship). Refilled at colonies and depots.

components.name: Fleet Command Network
components.description: While this ship survives, every ship in its fleet gets +10% accuracy and +5% evasion, and the fleet maneuvers as one (+1 maneuver). Battleship or larger.

aiPersonalities.name: Expansionist
aiPersonalities.description: Settles everything it can reach and defends what it holds.

aiPersonalities.name: Turtle
aiPersonalities.description: Builds up behind strong defenses and rarely strikes first.

aiPersonalities.name: Raider
aiPersonalities.description: Fast, cheap ships that hit weak colonies and run.

aiPersonalities.name: Warlord
aiPersonalities.description: Builds a big battle fleet and goes looking for a fight.

aiPersonalities.name: Technocrat
aiPersonalities.description: Out-researches rivals and fights with better ships.

difficulties.name: Easy
difficulties.description: AI empires produce and research 25% less.

difficulties.name: Hard
difficulties.description: AI empires produce, research and earn 40% more and see further.

taxLevels.name: Low
taxLevels.description: A credit per 4 population. Content citizens: +20% growth.

taxLevels.name: High
taxLevels.description: 3 credits per 4 population. Grumbling: -20% growth, -5% industry.

taxLevels.name: Crushing
taxLevels.description: A credit per population. Unrest: -40% growth, -10% industry and research.

species.name: Kraal
species.description: A hive that never stops working.

species.name: Aviari
species.description: Born to the void; their ships are swift.

species.name: Lithari
species.description: Living stone that thrives on dead worlds.
traits: Can settle hostile worlds (-30 habitability needed)
